custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two active parts for this test, part A and part C.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425732 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425732-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425732 PART C in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425732-C in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Create a canned job for this test, canned job A, holding part A with a part fee, fee 1, and part C with a part fee, fee 2.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425732 LINE C in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. Add p, a, r, t, s, , A, , a, n, d, , C to that line, one of each: in the line's Parts row click + Add Part, type the part number in Part number, pick the result that shows Inventory Qty, type 1 in Qty *, then click Save. Give each part its own fee from the part row's menu before saving the canned line. Then click the three-dot icon on the line, click Save as canned line, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C425732 CANNED JOB A in Line Title and click Save As Canned Line.
  • Set part A inactive after canned job A is saved.
    • How to do it: On the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C425732-A, click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window.
  • Create an open work order, work order 1, for this test, with no lines.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: close it with the X at its top right, so the work order has no lines.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The New Line window opens.

Step 2:

  • Canned job A is suggested.

Step 3:

  • The canned job A line is filled in.

Step 4:

  • Work order 1's new line holds part C with fee 2; neither part A nor fee 1 is on it.
  • One warning shows: "These parts are inactive and were not added:" followed by part A's part number, then "The", fee 1's name, "fee for", part A's part number and "was not added."
  • The warning stays until closed.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work)

  • S9-R10a: “When a part left out carries a fee, the fee is left out too, and the same warning adds "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." for each one.”
  • S9-R10: “When a canned job leaves out parts, the system shows one warning listing every part left out: "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." The warning stays until the user closes it.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Canned job leaves out inactive parts | "These parts are inactive and were not added: {part numbers}." plus "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added." for each fee left out | Warning toast, one per canned job, stays until closed”

From: Jira tickets and comments under epic SV-10647 (saved in sources/jira-2026-10-27/ALL-TICKETS-2026-10-27.md), read 27 Oct 2026

  • SV-10822 acceptance criteria: “Given one of those parts carries a fee, when the job is applied, then the fee is left out and the same warning adds "The {fee} fee for {part number} was not added."”

Partly checked against build v26.43.4-999c51d (QA site sv10647) on 11/3/2026; not yet seen on that build: adding a fee to a part row.

References from Design

Design canvas "Parts Lifecycle Update" (https://claude.ai/artifact/Vz6rprcWyP16tYxzM1kdeE), 13 Oct 2026 copy, unchanged when re-read on 27 Oct 2026: boards "6.4 A canned job that holds it", "6.5 The canned job leaves it out". Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the quotes above.
